lines.text: The two walk hand in hand.
This is the first time we've made it this far.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Yeah, we're almost there.
It feels like a dream.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I don't know. I think being together with you is more like a dream.
Heh... You really know how to make a guy's heart melt.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Hehehe...
The two continue walking while warmly joking with one another.
When they reach the edge of the city, they both stop.
They gaze at a church together.
It's on the verge of collapse, but the sight of it bathing in the full light of the sun,
with its stained glass windows glittering, is both beautiful and sacred.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Wow...
Let's go in.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Why?
I'm pretty sure places like that usually have a legendary sword in them or something.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Haha... Okay, sure. Let's go.
*Creeeak*
The church door swings open noisily.
Thick dust drifts in the sunlight like a mist.
It's clear no humans have been inside for a long time,
but the warmth and sanctity of the place have not faded in the slightest.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Wow... It's beautiful.
Now I'm 100% certain. This is definitely where we'll find the ultimate weapon to defeat the demon king.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Hehe... Shall we start looking for it, then?
Let's do it. Whoever finds it first gets to ask the other for a wish.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Deal. Get ready to lose.
Let's meet back here in thirty minutes.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Okay.
The two laugh as they run off in opposite directions.
Marian wanders around the inside of the church, her heart fluttering.
It's a large space with many rooms, along with different facilities, although none of it works anymore.
She doesn't really think she'll find anything special,
but being able to explore such a beautiful place while forgetting the fear of death, even if only for a short time, feels good.
Marian stops and looks at a large, ornate door.
It's the kind of door that likely leads to the most important room in the building. The design is unlike any door she's seen.
Marian smiles and pushes the great door open.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Whoa...
On the other side is a magnificent interior.
A room that bears the marks of time, yet whose nobility and beauty remain undiminished.
However, not even all of that combined can compare to what stands at the center.
Everything in this room, in this entire building, seems to exist for this one thing.
Marian stares, transfixed, at what stands at the heart of the spacious room.
She slowly approaches it, as if drawn by some mysterious force.
She reaches out and touches it, taking it all in. It's nearly enough to bring her to tears.
Marian decides to savor every bit of this blissful feeling.
The Commander searches the inside of the building from top to bottom.
Judging from the look of the building and the feel of the interior, he's sure there will be one here.
Of course, the object he's thinking of is not a legendary weapon to slay a demon king.
The Commander opens every drawer in every room.
He searches for a long while.
Eventually, he steps into a room with all manner of clothes in a line.
Finally, he sees it, placed with great care on the center table.
The Commander's heart beats faster. He rushes over and looks at it.
*Click*
... There you are.
The Commander jumps up and down. His face flushes and he can't hide his excitement.
He runs quickly toward the entrance.
The Commander stands in front of the altar, stamping his feet.
He now wishes he'd said twenty minutes.
He keeps fidgeting with something inside his pocket.
Then, a moment later, he hears footsteps from across the room.
The Commander takes a deep breath and waits for Marian.
*Click, clack*
... Hmm?
*Click, clack*
Those aren't Marian's footsteps.
The Commander's pulse starts to race as he becomes nervous.
He checks his pistol. It's where it should be. Eight rounds left, four extra magazines.
*Click, clack*
The footsteps draw closer.
Tension builds inside the Commander.
Then, from the dark, Marian steps into the light.

lines.speaker: marian_d
lines.text: Commander! Commander! Look at this!

lines.speaker: marian_d
lines.text: A wedding dress! An actual wedding dress! Hahaha!

lines.speaker: marian_d
lines.text: Someone must have been preparing for a wedding here!

lines.speaker: marian_d
lines.text: Isn't it beautiful? I've always dreamed of wearing a wedding dress...!

lines.speaker: marian_d
lines.text: ... Commander? Are you okay?
Marian studies the Commander's face. He seems to be in a daze. She approaches him.
The Commander can't take his eyes off Marian.

lines.speaker: marian_d
lines.text: Wh-what's wrong? Are you hurt?
Tears are streaming down the Commander's face.
They don't stop.

lines.speaker: marian_d
lines.text: Commander, what's...
You're so beautiful. Absolutely... beautiful.
Unbelievably so. Really.

lines.speaker: marian_d
lines.text: ... Beautiful enough to make you cry?
Yeah.

lines.speaker: marian_d
lines.text: Hehe.
Marian laughs softly and wipes the Commander's tears.

lines.speaker: marian_d
lines.text: I figured you'd like it and maybe make a bit of a fuss, but I did not expect this.
Sorry.

lines.speaker: marian_d
lines.text: No, what I meant was... I like this more.
... Marian.
The Commander takes a step back.
Marian looks at him with a puzzled expression.
As soon as he lowers to one knee, she clasps a hand over her mouth.
With trembling hands, the Commander reaches in his pocket.
He takes out a small box and sets it carefully in his palm.
*Click*
The box opens, revealing a sparkling ring.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... Commander...
His voice trembles, as does his body, but his eyes look straight up at her resolutely.
Marian holds back her tears and takes a step forward.
She holds out her hand and smiles.
The Commander looks at that familiar, beautiful smile.
The trembling stops.
The words he needs to say come to him clearly.
He gently takes Marian's hand,
and slides the ring onto her ring finger.
I swear to protect you forever, Marian.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... And I swear to protect you forever, Commander.
I love you.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I love you too.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Tomorrow, it'll be over.
Yeah. We're nearly there. We'll be finished before the afternoon.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I imagine the way there will be filled with danger.
Not a problem. It's us. We'll be all right.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Hehe, you're right. With you, I can grow strong enough to overcome anything.
Yeah. And when I'm around you, I'm invincible.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: ... It's taken so long to get here.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: So very, very long.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: If I hadn't met you, I probably would have never broken free from that endless loop.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: I'd have kept dying and coming back, over and over, for nothing.
I probably would've kept doing the same thing without even understanding why.
... I'm so glad I got to meet you, Marian.
I'm so glad that, thanks to you, I get to dream about the future.
... Thank you. For giving my life meaning.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: That's my line...
Marian nestles herself into the Commander's arms.
Her fingertips trace over him.
Carefully, gently, as if trying to memorize everything about him.
Th-that tickles.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Just a moment. Almost done with the scan.
We'll have plenty of time moving forward, you know.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Hehe. Still, I want to do this. And watching you squirm is fun too.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Hmm? What's this?
Oh, my collarbone? I don't really know either. It's just extra prominent, I guess.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Hehe. Interesting. I'll have to check if there are any spots like that.
Hehehe. That tickles.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Tickle, tickle, tickle...
H-hey, stop.
The Commander embraces Marian tightly.
Marian reciprocates, as though she'd been waiting for it.
They look at each other.
They kiss.
The night deepens.
The next day,
they walk hand-in-hand toward the target location.
The route is rife with Lord-class Raptures, but they aren't a problem for the couple.
For the two of them, simply seeing each other is enough to grant them strength.
They overcome whatever stands in their way. Again, and again, and again.
And together, they reach the target location.
A platform reminiscent of a lift sits alone in the center.
One look and they both know that this is the target location.
Holding hands, they walk toward it slowly.
They stop one step away from the platform.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: We finally made it.
Yeah. We did it.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Well, shall we?
Let's.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: On three, we step forward together. No cheating.
Do we go on three, or do we say three and then go?

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Let's go right when we say three.
Got it.

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: One, two...

lines.speaker: marian
lines.text: Three!
They both step forward together.
*Crackle, crackle, crack!*
Marian opens her eyes in her room.
